scene_analysis.scene_overview: A wide city street with a large building in the background, surrounded by trees and other buildings, with a few cars parked along the side of the road and a person crossing the street. The sky is blue with some clouds.
scene_analysis.buildings: The large building has a beige façade with many windows and balconies, while the surrounding buildings have a mix of white and brown facades.
scene_analysis.materials: The ground is paved with asphalt, and there are several trees lining the sidewalk.
scene_analysis.street_furniture: There are several tables and chairs set up outside a café, as well as a few motorcycles parked along the curb.
scene_analysis.vegetation: The trees are lush and green, providing shade for pedestrians.
scene_analysis.signage: There are several signs posted along the street, including a stop sign and a pedestrian crossing signal.
scene_analysis.as_resident: The area appears to be a popular spot for locals and tourists alike.
scene_analysis.as_student: The area is home to several young people studying or working in the nearby universities.
